name: fill_table_with_free_marker

name: run_sentinel_terminated_scan

name: set_high_bits_on_byte

name: subtract_six_from_word_field

name: add_six_to_word_field
description: Calls a routine, then increases the word at offset two of the record in the address register by six.

name: subtract_eight_from_word_field
description: Decreases the word at offset two of the record in the address register by eight and returns; it is reached through a gap in the decoded code.

name: adjust_record_word_pair_mixed

name: increment_record_word_pair
description: Increases the word at offset two by six and the word at offset four by five in the record at the address register.

name: step_frame_index_forward
description: Advances the byte at offset one of the record by two when bit six of the first byte is clear, or by one when it is set, wrapping to zero past the upper limit, which looks like cycling a frame index.

name: step_frame_index_backward
description: Moves the byte at offset one of the record back by two when bit six of the first byte is clear, or by one when it is set, wrapping to the top index below the lower limit.

name: reset_record_from_table_entry
description: Loads a pointer from a table chosen by a record index, copies a word and a long from it into the record, zeroes a long counter field, and clears 137 consecutive long words of shared memory.

name: advance_timed_event_queue
description: Returns early if a busy flag is set; otherwise it advances a counter and, when it reaches the scheduled value, either flags the record to advance or pops the next queued entry and copies its fields into a 24-entry table of 11-word records.

name: update_script_slot_table
description: Walks a 24-slot table adjusting each active slot's timer; expired slots read a byte stream and dispatch each byte through an indirect routine table, and slots that leave their range are deactivated.

name: build_tiered_record_entry
description: Chooses a tier from thresholds on a position word, combines it with a base offset picked by the type byte, appends a four-word record to an output list, and stores computed values and table lookups back into the source record.

name: lookup_table_value_with_offset
description: Returns the 16-bit entry from a table selected by a shared index word, added to the input value and to a fixed offset of 176.

name: clear_thirty_long_table
description: Writes zero into 30 consecutive long-word slots of the shared table and returns.

name: emit_active_entries_and_age

name: call_routine_four_times
description: Calls the same routine four times in a row and returns.

name: allocate_first_free_slot
description: Scans 15 eight-byte slots for the first free one, then stores the long value passed in the address register there, sets a word field to five and clears the following word.

name: store_slot_record_fields
description: Stores the long value passed in the address register into a slot, sets the word at offset six to five and clears the word at offset four.

name: advance_slot_animation_and_emit
description: Walks 15 slots; each active slot either counts down a delay or steps its frame index, deactivating it past the last frame, then appends a four-word record built from the slot's referenced data to the output list.

name: clear_forty_long_table
description: Writes zero into 40 consecutive long-word slots of the shared table and returns.

name: advance_counter_match_flags
description: Increments the counter byte in the record and compares it with a table entry picked by a record word; on a match it resets the counter and returns a status word that signals the match.

name: advance_counter_match_result
description: Increments the counter byte in the record and compares it with a table entry picked by a record word, returning zero on a match and minus one otherwise, resetting the counter on a match.

name: advance_counter_against_global
description: Increments the counter byte in the record and compares it with a shared global byte; on a match it resets the counter and returns zero, otherwise minus one.

name: spawn_free_slot_and_encode
description: When a flag is clear and a routine reports ready, copies three words from the source record into the first free slot of a 10-entry table, stores a value from another routine plus fixed fields into the new record, and writes display-style byte values to the shared global.

name: update_moving_slots_and_emit
description: Walks ten 16-byte slots, stepping each slot's position words by its velocity words and moving them toward a target by a fixed step, clears slots that leave the allowed range, and appends a four-word record for slots that stay.

name: run_oscillating_state_machine
description: Runs an oscillating counter that bounces within fixed limits and fills a five-entry table of sizes and indices; when a flag and a ready check pass, it places a record into the first free slot of a 10-entry table. The decoded code ends in invalid instruction bytes, so the tail is unreliable.

name: append_four_word_record

name: shared_word_move_entry

name: update_state_and_append_records

name: update_shared_counter_state_records
description: Performs essentially the same state update and two-record append as its neighbour, but keeps the adjusted value in the shared counter word and also calls two routines.

name: clear_four_long_table
description: Writes zero into four consecutive long-word slots of the shared table and returns.

name: countdown_flagged_timer

name: stub_return_only

name: bounce_level_counter_and_pulse

name: decrement_timer_step_value
description: Decrements a countdown byte in the record and, when it reaches zero, reloads it from a table, stopping when the table entry is zero; otherwise it advances an index and adds a table delta to a value byte.

name: update_custom_chip_channel
description: Updates a per-channel state record and writes the resulting level and period words to custom chip registers at the channel's offset, with decay and oscillation applied on alternating passes.

name: clear_channel_state_table
description: Clears one flag byte and four shared state bytes to zero, then writes the value 255 and the value 15 to the shared global, resetting a set of per-channel slots.

name: decode_byte_stream_commands

name: decode_byte_stream_with_header

name: decode_byte_stream_flagged

name: decode_stream_mark_active
description: Sets one status bit in the record, then runs the same byte-stream decoding loop, dispatching top-bit codes through an indirect table and storing the stream position.

name: init_record_and_decode_stream

name: load_record_scale_and_decode

name: store_byte_and_decode_stream
description: Stores the first stream byte into a record field and then runs the byte-stream decoding loop.

name: tick_stream_timer_and_decode

name: finish_stream_step
description: When the record's flag at offset thirty-six is clear, it clears one field, sets a countdown to two and stores a shared value; then it copies a pending counter into the active counter and stores the stream position difference.

name: load_table_entry_into_record

name: update_channel_pointer_and_length

description: Compares a shared byte with a shifted copy of its complement; when they match it calls a routine through the library base pointer and returns that result, otherwise it returns the shared byte.

name: set_blitter_masks_and_jump
description: Writes a pointer value and two blitter mask words, all ones for the first-word mask and 32767 for the last-word mask, then calls a routine through an unrecovered jump table.

name: patch_matching_table_entries
description: Walks a table of word pairs and, wherever a word matches the input and the following word equals 88, overwrites that entry with a fixed long value.

name: store_word_and_wait_blitter
description: Stores the input data-register word at offset 88 of the record and then waits in a loop until the blitter-busy bit clears.

name: store_word_d2_wait_blitter
description: Stores the data-register-two word at offset 88 of the record, then waits until the blitter-busy bit clears.

name: store_word_d3_wait_blitter
description: Stores the data-register-three word at offset 88 of the record, then waits until the blitter-busy bit clears.

name: store_word_d4_wait_blitter
description: Stores the data-register-four word at offset 88 of the record, then waits until the blitter-busy bit clears.

name: store_word_d0_wait_blitter
description: Stores the data-register-zero word at offset 88 of the record and then waits until the blitter-busy bit clears.

name: store_global_word_wait_blitter
description: Stores the shared global word at offset 88 of the record and waits until the blitter-busy bit clears.

name: store_global_word_wait_blitter
description: Stores the shared global word at offset 88 of the record and waits until the blitter-busy bit clears.

name: store_param_word_wait_blitter
description: Stores the word passed as its parameter at offset 88 of the record and waits until the blitter-busy bit clears.

name: store_long_low_word_wait
description: Stores the low word of its long parameter at offset 88 of the record and waits until the blitter-busy bit clears.

name: store_constant_and_wait_blitter
description: Stores the fixed value 524 at offset 88 of the record and waits until the blitter-busy bit clears.

name: write_constants_return_fixed_value
description: Writes three fixed values into a block of memory and returns a fixed long constant.

name: swap_word_runs_in_place
description: Swaps words between a forward pointer and a backward pointer, one pair per pass, for a count taken from the data register, which reverses a run of words in place.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Stores one constant and then reaches invalid instruction bytes, so the body is truncated and no reliable behaviour is described.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Stores one constant and then reaches invalid instruction bytes, so the body is truncated and no reliable behaviour is described.

name: store_constant_two_and_return
description: Stores the constant two to a shared location and returns.

name: store_constant_one_then_halt
description: Stores the constant one to a shared location and then reaches invalid instruction bytes, so the tail is unreliable.

name: dispatch_code_then_call_base
description: Compares a 16-bit code parameter with two fixed negative values; one match calls a routine through the library base pointer and then another routine, while other values call a different base routine and return. The text Disk.2 is referenced.

name: add_constant_across_table_rows
description: Walks packed entries on the stack, adding a fixed long constant to memory locations selected by nibbles of each entry, and writes the same constant to the shared global.

name: add_constant_table_walk_variant
description: Performs the same table walk as its neighbour but returns early with the shared global written when an entry's count is zero.

name: call_base_offset_four
description: Calls a routine through the library base pointer at a small fixed offset and returns.

name: negate_word_then_halt
description: Negates a 16-bit field at a large fixed offset from the address register and then reaches invalid instruction bytes, so the tail is unreliable.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Entry reaches invalid instruction bytes at once, so it has no described behaviour.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Entry reaches invalid instruction bytes at once, so it has no described behaviour.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Entry reaches invalid instruction bytes at once, so it has no described behaviour.

name: call_two_routines_passthrough
description: Calls two other routines in sequence and returns the register pair unchanged.

name: call_two_routines_passthrough
description: Calls two other routines in sequence and returns the register pair unchanged.

name: save_state_enable_interrupt_bit
description: Saves the shared global word into two memory slots, then writes a pointer value and a set-bit interrupt-enable word to the shared global.

name: restore_interrupt_request_state
description: When a saved status word has its bit 5 set, writes the value 32 to the shared global, then writes back the saved word.

name: check_interrupt_bit_then_halt
description: Reads a status register and masks bit 5; when it is set it writes that value and calls a routine, then reaches invalid instruction bytes, so the tail is unreliable.

name: scan_rows_clear_slot_table
description: Scans byte rows until it finds a free index, clears a 30-long slot table with pointer links, sets a status bit, and writes a fixed set of zero fields to the shared global.

name: write_fifteen_then_four_zeros
description: Writes the value 15 followed by four zero values to the shared global.

name: reset_audio_pointers_and_advance
description: Advances a shared counter and, when the counter condition holds, waits in two timing loops, sets the top bit of a shared global, copies eight table words into the audio channel start-pointer registers, and advances an index until it reaches 1024.

name: update_channel_record_and_commands
description: Loads a record from a stream, derives its start pointer and length from a table, stores masked word fields, and dispatches a command nibble that toggles a flag, sets a value or updates a counter; it touches the audio channel start and length registers and the DMA control.

name: dispatch_channel_command_slide
description: Decodes a channel command nibble and applies its effect to a record through table-driven pitch lookups, slides, volume-style steps and offset steps, with some commands writing to the output; it also reads the fire-button input register.

name: setup_display_interrupts_and_fill
description: Builds a stack-resident table of pointers, adds a fixed long constant to rows of memory, copies a block of longs into shared memory, writes display and interrupt-enable registers, clears sprite and colour areas, and returns a constant; it loops forever if one of its calls fails.

name: unresolved_routine_17_instr
description: A 17-instruction routine called from one place; the decompiler timed out, so no further behaviour is available.

name: spin_forever_unless_flag
description: Returns when the zero flag is set; otherwise it spins in an endless loop.

name: spin_forever_loop
description: Loops forever with no other work in the decoded body.

name: initialise_record_and_ramp_table
description: Clears several record fields, fills a 16-byte table with values that step by 8000 from a source long, copies the stepped value into four record slots, and sets two more fields.

name: copy_global_words_strided
description: Copies 16 words from the shared global into it at a stride of two words, overwriting part of the block, and returns the input register unchanged.

name: set_flag_one
description: Sets a shared flag word to one and returns.

name: advance_step_counter_on_timer
description: Clears a flag and resets the step counter when the flag is set, then decrements a timer; when the timer expires it reloads it and, while the step is below 16, advances the step and calls a routine.

name: update_nibble_grid_flags
description: Walks a 16-row grid of packed nibble values, adding a fixed bit pattern to rows where a mask comparison shows a change, then calls a routine.

name: wait_until_routine_reports_one
description: Stores two values derived from a constant, makes a call, then repeatedly calls a routine until it returns one.

name: check_status_bits_and_code
description: Returns zero when two status bits in the shared global are set and a stored value is neither of two codes; otherwise it returns minus one.

name: clear_big_table_then_wait
description: Clears a 2048-long table, copies a few words into place, calls a routine, then calls it repeatedly until it returns one.
